home.hero.tagline: Where students, researchers and the industry meet
home.hero.description: Faithful to its roots, SEI keeps its vision to bring on the stage students and professionals in the field of Informatics Engineering to share, debate, and reflect on the research, developments, and practices in this field.
home.registration.heading: Participation is free, but registration is mandatory.
home.registration.description: Paper submission and registration deadlines for {edition} are yet to be announced.
home.about.heading: One day. Every branch of Informatics Engineering.
home.about.paragraph1: SEI welcomes students and professionals in the field of Informatics Engineering to share, debate, and reflect on the research, developments, and practices in this field.
home.about.paragraph2: Organised by ISEP, the symposium is a meeting point between the academic community — BSc, MSc and PhD students, teachers and researchers — and the professionals who work in the industry. Submissions are peer reviewed, published and presented in a single track.
home.proceedings.heading: Every accepted paper, published
home.proceedings.description: The proceedings gather the accepted papers presented at the symposium, with an ISBN and a DOI per edition. The {edition} volume will be published after the event.
home.proceedings.pending: The proceedings will be published after the event.
